CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.file_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.tenant_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.opaque_key,NEW.upload_key,NEW.media_type,NEW.max_bytes,NEW.expires_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.tenant_id,OLD.purpose,OLD.opaque_key,OLD.upload_key,OLD.media_type,OLD.max_bytes,OLD.expires_at)
     OR (OLD.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND ROW(NEW.sha256,NEW.byte_count) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.sha256,OLD.byte_count))
     OR NEW.claim_generation < OLD.claim_generation
     OR (OLD.state='ready' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('ready','cleanup'))
     OR (OLD.state='failed' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('failed','cleanup'))
     OR (OLD.state='cleanup' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('cleanup','purged'))
     OR (OLD.state='purged' AND NEW.state<>'purged') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable_file_identity' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.immutable_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable_identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.witness_clock()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.request_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_id AND (
    ROW(NEW.requested_at,NEW.cancel_until) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.requested_at,OLD.cancel_until)
    OR (OLD.live_purged_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.live_purged_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.live_purged_at)
    OR (OLD.copy_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.copy_expires_at IS NULL OR NEW.copy_expires_at>OLD.copy_expires_at))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable_lifecycle_clock' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.access_session(handle uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(account_id uuid, registration_state text, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO '<schema>', 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT a.id,a.registration_state,s.expires_at FROM auth_session s
  JOIN account a ON a.auth_user_id=s.user_id
  WHERE s.id=handle AND s.expires_at>clock_timestamp() FOR SHARE OF s,a
$function$
functions.name: access_session

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.purge_organization_person_history(org uuid, subject uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO '<schema>', 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM organization_person_removal w JOIN person p ON p.id=w.person_record_id AND p.organization_id=w.organization_id
 WHERE w.organization_id=org AND w.person_record_id=subject AND p.state='retired' FOR SHARE OF w,p;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'removal_witness_required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 UPDATE audit_event SET before_value=NULL,after_value=NULL,reason=NULL,actor_token=coalesce(actor_token,encode(sha256(convert_to(tenant_id::text||'/'||actor_id::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),actor_id=NULL,result=NULL,request_identity=NULL WHERE tenant_id=org AND subject_id=subject;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.revoke_removed_seat_sessions(subject uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO '<schema>', 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM seat WHERE account_id=subject AND ended_at IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM seat WHERE account_id=subject AND ended_at IS NULL)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 DELETE FROM auth_session WHERE user_id=(SELECT auth_user_id FROM account WHERE id=subject);
END $function$
